description: Generate a color palette using color theory harmonies (monochromatic, analogous, complementary, split-complementary, triadic, tetradic, square, compound, shades-and-tints). Defaults to perceptual HCT space, avoids universally disliked colors, and describes each swatch so agents can see what was generated.

allowDisliked.description: Allow dark yellow-green 'bile zone' colors (default false)

includeDetails.description: Include perceptual name, temperature, tone, and best text ink for each swatch

space.description: Wheel space: 'hct' (perceptual default), 'oklch' (CSS perceptual), 'ryb' (painter's red-yellow-blue wheel), or 'hsl'

name: generate_palette
